text:
support-ella: Heads-up — multiple customers reporting per-model throughput lines missing on Console since ~09:00 UTC. Dashboards show flat zero for every model. https://console.redwood/internal/dashboards/throughput (screenshot attached).

maya_oncall: seeing same. sparklines and per-model QPS panels are zeroed out across all teams. Prometheus targets look healthy though.

sam_platform: any recent metric changes?

ops-bot: deploy: exporter-service v2.3.0 rolled to prod at 02:15 UTC yesterday (change-id: dep-2028).

maya_oncall: quick checks: curl to /metrics on gateway returns lines with label 'model="rwd-embed-small"' (not model_id). Example: `redwood_inference_requests_total{model="rwd-embed-small",region="us-east-1"} 12345`.

sam_platform: ah — we normalized labels in the exporter to use `model` (dropped `model_id`) to match new onboarding. Dashboards were still grouped by `model_id`. That mismatch would produce empty series in Grafana.

maya_oncall: repro steps I used:
1) `curl -s https://gateway.internal/metrics | rg redwood_inference_requests_total`
2) `PromQL: sum(rate(redwood_inference_requests_total[1m])) by (model_id)` => 0 series
3) `PromQL: sum(rate(redwood_inference_requests_total[1m])) by (model)` => returns ~N series matching traffic

lucas_sre: can either update Grafana queries or put a Prometheus relabel to copy `model` -> `model_id`. Relabel is infra change and affects many dashboards. Safer to update dashboards first.

sam_platform: I can push a hotfix to the dashboard config to group by `model` instead of `model_id` for the per-model panels. Will do a small patch + commit to dashboard repo.

support-ella: customers flagged: 3 enterprise accounts (acct A/B/C). They need a note once metrics visible again.

sam_platform: PATCH going out now. changing these panels: `Per model - QPS`, `Per model - Avg latency`, `Per model - error-rate` to use `by (model)` and fallback to `label_replace(..., \"model\", \"${1}\", \"model_id\", \"(.*)\")` where necessary.

grafana-bot: dashboard:updated dashboard-id=thruput-21 change=panel-query (sam_platform)

sam_platform: confirmed — Grafana shows restored lines locally. Pushing to prod dashboard service.

maya_oncall: verified in prod: per-model lines are back for all clusters. Ran the PromQL checks, results match.

lucas_sre: long-term fix: exporter should emit both labels for backward compatibility (`model` and `model_id`) for at least one release cycle. Filing follow-up ticket.

sam_platform: created issue RN-412: "exporter: keep model_id alias for compatibility" and PR queued for exporters.

support-ella: thanks. I’ll update the three customers and close the escalations after confirmation.

maya_oncall: closing on-call loop. If anything else pops, ping here. :thumbsup:

support-ella: closing escalation — customers notified, they confirmed metrics restored. :white_check_mark:
